title: National Assembly Adopts Law Requiring Victim Notification on Assailant Release
detail: France's National Assembly adopted a law requiring the justice system to formally notify victims of sexual violence when their assailant is released from prison. The measure addresses a long-standing gap in victim protections, ensuring survivors are not left uninformed when their perpetrator re-enters society. The bill passed with broad cross-party support amid wider legislative discussions on justice reform and victim rights.

media.caption: National Assembly votes to require notification of sexual violence victims upon assailant release
